core.title: Antique Round Swing Pull, Acorn IP4BP

text.description_html:
Acorn IP4BP, Antique Round Swing Pull

Hand forged using the traditional hammer and anvil, the Antique Round Swing Pull has an old world feel that makes it perfect for restoration projects. The decorative mount adds a bit of whimsy and movement to the ring pull to keep it from looking too static. The black iron finish mimics the look of naturally weathered metal. It is backed by a lifetime finish warranty.

For over a half a century authenticity and function have been the way Acorn Manufacturing has produced some of the highest quality forged hardware and accessories from some of New England's finest Blacksmiths for your home.

Specifications of the Antique Round Swing Pulls:

  • Finish: Black Iron
  • Height: 3"
  • Width: 2-1/4"
  • Package includes 1 pull and hardware for installation.
  • Lifetime No-Rust Warranty!

Sold individually. Due to the handmade craftsman nature of this product, all dimensions are approximate.
